title: pvLocationSelectionSource
body:
## pvLocationSelectionSource

Creates a location selection from world-space points. With FieldType CELL (the ParaView default) it selects the cells that contain each location; with POINT it selects mesh points located at each location. The output is a vtkSelection (no geometry) for the Selection port of pvExtractSelection or pvAnnotateSelection. To sample interpolated values at a point instead, use pvExtractLocation or pvProbeLocation.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- With FieldType POINT the search radius is 0, so only a mesh point exactly at the location matches; use CELL selection or probing for arbitrary positions.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `LocationSelectionSource`. Identity: `sources/LocationSelectionSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ContainingCells` | When field type is POINT, this controls whether single vertex cells will be produced for each selected point, or whether the cells that contain each selected point will be produced. When field type is CELL this has no effect. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FieldType` | The location of the array the selection came from (e.g. point, cell). | `{"type":"enum","values":["CELL","POINT","FIELD","VERTEX","EDGE","ROW"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"CELL"` |
| `InsideOut` | When this property is false the selection describes everything that should be extracted. When this is true the selection describes everything that should NOT be extracted. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Locations` | The list of locations that will be added to the selection produced by the selection source. Complete tuples of 3 values. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `NumberOfLayers` | Specify the number of layers of connected elements to include in the selection. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `RemoveIntermediateLayers` | When using NumberOfLayers, this controls if intermediate layers are removes or not. Default is false. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `RemoveSeed` | When using NumberOfLayers, this controls if the initial seed selection is remove or not. Default is false. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvLocationSelectionSource"
}
```
